## Project Overview
A Rust-based chronological sentiment / trading replay system with a React UI (`my-chrono-sentiment-ui`). The project includes replay certification infrastructure, historical tick replay, strategy identity verification, and a deterministic release pipeline. Active branch: `post-qfth/cert-restore-and-gulf-validation`.

## Completed Work
1. `cargo clean` — freed 2.8GiB (11663 files removed)
2. `cargo check` — verified E0599 fix compiles clean (warnings only)
3. Committed `ga.rs` E0599 fix — commit `7f957b6c`
4. Confirmed `capture_types.rs` does not exist; Lane 2 not open
5. Generated affected-file inventory for Unit A3
6. Executed Unit A3 — API/core routing isolation — commit `38a4d4f1`
7. Executed Unit A4 — UI isolation (observer-only projection hygiene) — commit `8743b76b`
8. Phase 2 verification — `cargo check` clean (warnings only); `cargo test` running clean
9. Phase 3 pause — replay certification → observational soak → reassess
10. Operational sprint Step 1: `cargo test replay` PASS (1/0), `cargo test chronology` PASS (0/0), `verify_strategy_identity_fixtures.py` PASS (8 records), `verify_chronology_byte_fixtures.py` PASS (3 fixtures)
11. Appended certification baseline results to ledger — commit `b7f760e5`
12. Operational sprint Step 2: historical cohort replay (2 reruns, all PASS) — commit `f8e3e1c4`
13. Step 3 Sub-steps 1–4: re-ran certified historical cohort anchor (4 suites PASS), bounded live ingress session, replay comparison loop, ledger append — commit `ba7bb672`
14. Steady-state cadence run: `cargo test replay` (6/0), fixture verifications (3+8 PASS), hash comparison (byte-identical to certified baseline), ledger append (3 rows) — commit `d533d4c7`
15. Certification window formally closed — 2026-05-27T06:13 IST; transition to bounded operational development confirmed
16. Release hardening sprint — all 4 units committed as `1f21e2e7` (4 files, 834 insertions):
    - Unit 1: `scripts/verify_release_consistency.sh`
    - Unit 2: `scripts/operator_bootstrap.sh`
    - Unit 3: `scripts/generate_release_manifest.sh` + `docs/releases/README.md`
    - Unit 4: `scripts/replay_smoke_suite.sh`
    - Pre-merge gate: 6 passed, 0 failed — no replay regression
17. Release hardening sprint formally complete — `attempt_completion` delivered with full deliverable summary and recommended release workflow

## Key Technical Decisions
- Replay certification is the primary correctness guardrail; all development gated behind it
- Observer-only projection hygiene enforced in UI layer (Unit A4)
- API/core routing isolated from UI concerns (Unit A3)
- Deterministic double-build binary hash comparison used as release gate
- Release manifests stored as versioned JSON under `docs/releases/`
- All release/hardening scripts are read-only with respect to replay semantics, ontology, and tranche-gated surfaces
- Baseline for smoke suite resolved automatically from certification ledger
- `verify_release_consistency.sh` supports `--skip-double-build` flag
- `generate_release_manifest.sh` supports `--skip-build`, `--skip-double-build`, `--notes` flags

## Relevant Files & Code
- `src/ga.rs` — E0599 fix applied (commit `7f957b6c`)
- `scripts/verify_release_consistency.sh` — full release gate (build ×2, binary hash, replay tests, fixture verification, git state)
- `scripts/operator_bootstrap.sh` — single-command pre-flight (7 sections; exits 0=READY / 1=NOT READY)
- `scripts/generate_release_manifest.sh` — captures git state, environment, corpus SHA-256s, replay results, binary hash into versioned JSON
- `scripts/replay_smoke_suite.sh` — fast post-deploy smoke gate; resolves baseline from ledger automatically; exits 0=PASS / 1=FAIL
- `docs/releases/README.md` — release manifest schema documentation, filename convention, retention policy, release workflow
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/ComparisonPanels.js` — UI component (open in editor)
- `DISCREPANCY_REPORT.md` — open in editor
- `schemas/canonical/replay_response.schema.json` — canonical schema (open in editor)
- `schemas/canonical/observatory_state.schema.json` — canonical schema (open in editor)
- `schemas/canonical/governor_telemetry.schema.json` — canonical schema (open in editor)

## Current Status
Release hardening sprint fully complete and formally closed. All four operational hardening units committed as `1f21e2e7` on branch `post-qfth/cert-restore-and-gulf-validation`. Pre-merge gate passed (6/0). `attempt_completion` delivered. Recommended release workflow is operational:
```bash
bash scripts/operator_bootstrap.sh
bash scripts/verify_release_consistency.sh
bash scripts/generate_release_manifest.sh
git add docs/releases/<manifest>.json && git commit
```

## Pending Tasks
None explicitly requested. Branch is ready for merge or next development phase — awaiting direction.
